Noah: Quick findings from the helix8b-lite quant sweep on GTN long-doc summarization slice. Sharing numbers + conservative traffic plan.
Claire: Please include cost delta, ROUGE-L delta, latency p95, and human QA notes.
Noah: Short summary: int4 yields ~3x token cost savings vs int8 but degrades multi-paragraph summarization quality. Safe for short answers/embeddings.
Noah: Benchmarks: 
```
- baseline (fp16/int8 hybrid): p50 235ms, p95 690ms, cost/token $0.0016, ROUGE-L 42.7
- int8 optimized: p50 220ms, p95 655ms, cost/token $0.00135, ROUGE-L 42.3 (-0.4)
- int4 (q4_0): p50 210ms, p95 615ms, cost/token $0.00056, ROUGE-L 40.5 (-2.2)
- int4+prune: p50 205ms, p95 720ms, cost/token $0.00047, ROUGE-L 38.8 (-3.9)
```
Noah: Human QA (n=50 long docs): major factual issues -> baseline 1/50, int8 2/50, int4 8/50.
Ibrahim: For GTN this looks risky if we put long summaries on int4. Are there slices where int4 is fine?
Noah: Yes: single-paragraph summaries (<300 tokens), short Q/A completions, and embeddings/rerank show negligible delta.
Jo: Proposed routing: detect request_kind + simple output_length heuristic. Route longform -> int8/baseline, short/completions/embeddings -> int4.
Claire: What blended savings can we expect with that split?
Noah: Using our profile (long 46% tokens, short 29%, embeddings 25%), routing short+embeddings to int4 gives ~25-28% blended cost reduction vs all-int8. Adding a prefix cache for longform could add another ~5% savings.
Ibrahim: Implementation notes: cheap length estimator, route table by request_kind, quick sanity scorer (factuality + length check) with sync retry to int8 if below threshold.
Jo: Canary plan: 1) 5% GTN traffic for 24h (short+embeddings -> int4) 2) run 100 adversarial entity-dense prompts on int4 outputs 3) gate to 25% for 48h if ROUGE-L drop <=1.0 and hallucination increase <=1pp 4) require full GTN regression before >30% traffic.
Claire: Product asked for hallucination delta <0.5pp. Recommend conservative ramp and auto-rollback if daily spike >0.6pp.
ops-bot: canary-create helix8b-lite-hybrid -> started (canary=4198, traffic=5%) :rocket:
Noah: I'll drop per-slice avg tokens and attach a 24h scorecard after ops-bot ingest.
Ibrahim: Also run a warmstart cache on frequent prefixes for long summaries to lower int8 spend.
Jo: Thanks all. I'll draft the GTN readout and schedule the adversarial pass.
ops-bot: metrics ingestion scheduled (interval=10m). Canary telemetry will surface to the experiment dashboard. :white_check_mark:
